https://atid.store.core_purpose: The site facilitates online retail shopping, enabling users to browse, purchase, and manage orders for various products.
business_requirements: Users must be able to browse product categories and view detailed product descriptions, images, and pricing.
Users must be able to add products to a shopping cart and review their selections before proceeding to checkout.
Users must be able to create an account or log in to manage their profile, view purchase history, and save payment methods.
Users must be able to complete purchases securely using multiple payment options at checkout.
Users must be able to receive automated email confirmations and updates about their orders after a transaction is completed.
Administrators must be able to manage inventory, update product information, and process orders through a backend system.
The site must provide responsive design to ensure usability across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
